diagnosis.failure_mode: The policy network is not being updated during training. Policy loss is essentially zero (magnitude ~1e-7 to 1e-8), KL divergence remains exactly 0.0, clipfrac is exactly 0.0, and entropy stays constant at log(2)=0.6931472 (indicating a uniform random policy over 2 actions). The policy network parameters are not changing throughout training, likely because gradients are not flowing to the policy network - either the policy loss computation is detached from the computational graph, or the gradient update is not being applied to the policy parameters. Meanwhile, the value function is learning normally (value loss decreases from ~28 to ~14, explained variance increases from ~0.005 to ~0.42), confirming that the optimizer and general training loop work correctly but only the policy update pathway is broken.
